inference.se: cluster-robust sandwich of the per-parent mean (CR1), Student-t with G-1 df

native.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df

native+ac.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df

native+ac_drift.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df

native+pacing.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df

native+urgency.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df

signal.units: z-score of the alpha's expected_return per instrument on this dataset

simulator.note: costs are replay + adder: simulated fills never move the replayed book
